text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain police arrests rioters destroying public and private property in Sanabis village.
- Bahrain breaches barriers to lucrative trade in the giant European Union markets.
- Around 111,000 people visited Bahrain in May this year compared with 104,000 in May last year.
- Bahrain-based First Islamic Investment Bank equity placement oversubscribed.
- Bahrain chamber of commerce organises a seminar on privatisation in water and electricity sectors on June 17.
- Prime minister confirms intention to link Bahrain's bourse to other Arab bourses.
- Arab International Insurance Company raises its capital to $25 million from $7 million.
